# F-Droid catalog assets

English and Russian descriptions, titles, icons and versionCode14 changelogs
are under `metadata/android/`. Both locales use the same eight English UI
screenshots so the UI examples are readable internationally.

These are unedited copies from `docs/screenshots/`, captured from the running
Android API36 ARM64 app. The public conversation is scripted through a loopback
**Demo provider**, not generated by a cloud account or a local model. No private
phone data or credentials are shown. Capture provenance and hashes are in
`docs/screenshots/capture.json`; the displayed UI came from0.6.4-dev and is
unchanged in the corresponding0.6.6 screens. The older About screenshot is not
used in the catalog.

Screenshot order: home dark, chat dark, settings dark, home light, chat light,
storage light, Hugging Face light, settings light. Icons are exact copies of the
app's existing opaque high-density launcher resource. No generated mockups.

F-Droid processes and strips image metadata itself. Neither these files nor the
recipe imply a catalog listing or accepted submission. Catalog assets must be
present in the public release revision F-Droid checks out.
